video_title: Boogie, Chandler & Lou CONFUSED by LaMelo Ball to Timberwolves!!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on LaMelo Ball's trade to the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I think it's a great move for Minnesota. They've been in search of a point guard.
quotes.quote: It was a bit of a shock. The news broke last night or a couple days ago as far as there being some conversations around LaMelo Ball. I didn't expect it to happen as quickly as it did. I think it's a great move for Minnesota. They've been in search of a point guard to pair with Anthony Edwards. This is a fun, exciting point guard, a fun playmaker who plays with a lot of good, energetic energy. I think that'll be a good mesh with him and Ant. Two charismatic type of players. I think that could be something really special, something maybe the league hasn't seen in a while.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons questions if the LaMelo Ball trade improves Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: I just don't know if this makes them better.
quotes.quote: I know they need a point guard. You hear the Ja Morant, you hear the Kyrie Irvings and obviously the Charlotte Hornets have been shopping LaMelo Ball for quite some time now. At the expense of Naz Reid and basically Julius Randle, I just don't know if this makes them better. I think LaMelo Ball is exciting, I think he's young, I think it's a great backcourt that they can have for years to come, but they got to have to obviously figure out the chemistry and how to play.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams praises Minnesota for aggressively pursuing an All-Star point guard
quotes.excerpt: If you want an All-Star point guard to pair with your All-Star two/three, that's what you do.
quotes.quote: I say well done Minnesota. The reason I say that is they needed a point guard. They went out and they got one. From what I understand, they were making phone calls. They were trying to get every point guard of All-Star caliber that was available. Kyrie Irving was that play for a second, but I think Rudy Gobert was in those conversations and at the end of the day they decided to go in a different direction and they landed on LaMelo Ball. If you want an All-Star point guard to pair with your All-Star two/three, that's what you do. You get the best available guy.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons questions the logic of trading Naz Reid
quotes.excerpt: Once we saw the Julius Randle piece in that move, it was like, okay, Naz Reid.
quotes.quote: I think why I'm confused too is once we saw the Julius Randle piece in that move, it was like, okay, Naz Reid. Now you're the starting power forward. Now here's your opportunity. You've waited for this. Now you're getting this promotion and now they trade him. So I think that's part of the reason why I just didn't understand the Naz Reid aspect of it, especially when they have so many guards.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the importance of winning for young players
quotes.excerpt: At the end of the day, for me, it always becomes to a point with young players that winning is what matters.
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, for me, it always becomes to a point with young players that winning is what matters. They start seeing their peers have a certain level of success, they start seeing guys kind of pass them up and getting to a place in their career and they're like, you know what, I need that for me. I need those opportunities for myself. And I think LaMelo Ball is right there in that sweet spot.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on LaMelo Ball joining a winning team
quotes.excerpt: He's on a good team now. There's expectation. He's going to be on a relevant team.
quotes.quote: He's going to be in the playoffs. He's on a good team now. There's expectation. He's going to be on a relevant team. He's not just going to be this young, immature guard that we've talked about in the past that just puts up numbers on a bad team. Now he's on a really good team that's going to be in the postseason and he's going to play when it matters the most.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Charlotte Hornets' new additions
quotes.excerpt: They got the big fella from Washington, the German that grew up with his daddy played with Dirk.
quotes.quote: They did. They got the big fella from Washington, the German that grew up with his daddy played with Dirk and then they got Christian Wood, who our guy just said is possibly the steal of the draft. So he's going to get an immediate opportunity, but I still think they need kind of that vet point guard because obviously they have Brandon Miller. Khan had a great rookie year, they got some size with Moussa and Cockburn. Bridges is still there. They have a lot of talent, but now they need to fill that roster out and get a vet point guard.
